41.$description: Invented for light text.muted so supporting copy meets AA on canvas and card. Not on the landing.

700.$description: Invented for light action.destructive so error text meets AA on canvas and card. Not on the landing.

background.$description: Page canvas. Use instead of card when the surface is the window, not a raised panel.

card.$description: Raised panel on the canvas. Use instead of background for a contained block.

popover.$description: Overlay surface. Same swatch as card on the landing; use for menus and dropdowns, not page panels.

secondary.$description: Quiet fill behind a secondary control. Use instead of muted when the fill is a button, not a well.

muted.$description: Recessed well. Use instead of secondary when the block is not a control.

control.$description: Fill of a control that is not the primary action — switch off-track, field interior, disabled fill. Use instead of border.input, which is a hairline.

accent.$description: Brand chrome that is not the primary button — selected, highlight. Same swatch as action.primary on the landing.

foreground.$description: Default copy on background or card. Use instead of muted whenever the line must be read, not glanced.

muted.$description: Supporting copy. Do not use on muted or secondary surfaces — that pair fails AA.

secondary.$description: Brighter supporting copy than muted. Use when muted is too faint but the line is still not the title.

card.$description: Default copy on a card. Same swatch as text.foreground; keep the role for surfaces that are not the canvas.

popover.$description: Default copy on a popover. Same swatch as text.card; use only inside overlays.

primary.$description: Primary button fill and brand metric text on dark. Not for body copy. On light, fill only — never text.

primary-foreground.$description: Text and icons on a primary fill. Use instead of text.foreground, which is for dark canvas, not citron.

accent.$description: Selected or hover accent. Same swatch as primary on the landing; use when the control is not the main CTA.

accent-foreground.$description: Text on an accent fill. Same swatch as primary-foreground; keep the role next to action.accent.

destructive.$description: Danger text on dark canvas, as on the landing warning. Not a filled button — that pair fails AA.

destructive-foreground.$description: Text on a destructive fill. Landing does not show that button; the pair currently fails AA.

default.$description: Hairline between surfaces. Decorative — it does not meet 3:1 against the canvas.

input.$description: Field edge. Same swatch as border.default on the landing; use on controls, not panels.

ring.$description: Focus ring. Use instead of border.default when the edge must show keyboard focus.

night.$description: Night pill icon and label. Pair with activity.night-bg. Indigo — not citron.

night-bg.$description: Soft night pill fill. Text on this fill meets AA. Not a page surface.

morning.$description: Morning pill icon and label. Pair with activity.morning-bg. Amber, hue kept off citron.

morning-bg.$description: Soft morning pill fill. Text on this fill meets AA. Not a page surface.

day.$description: Day pill icon and label. Pair with activity.day-bg. Sky blue — yellow collides with the citron accent.

day-bg.$description: Soft day pill fill. Text on this fill meets AA. Not a page surface.

evening.$description: Evening pill icon and label. Pair with activity.evening-bg. Coral.

evening-bg.$description: Soft evening pill fill. Text on this fill meets AA. Not a page surface.

header.$description: Translucent header veil, slightly lighter than the dark page. Use with backdrop-blur. Not a text colour.

row-hover.$description: Translucent row hover, a step stronger than table.header. Not a text colour.

row-glow.$description: Soft glow on the trailing edge of a hovered row. Colour is color.citron.500; alpha is stored here because DTCG has no alpha-on-reference.

xl.$description: Landing step. No role uses this — typography.role.title uses size.base.

overline.$description: All-caps caption. Pair with weight.medium, tracking.wide, color.text.muted. Use instead of xs when the line is a caption, not copy.

hero.$description: Marketing H1 only. Do not use on the admin prototype.

display.$description: Section title on a marketing page. Use instead of hero when the line is a block heading, not the page H1.

title.$description: Card and panel title. Use on the prototype instead of display.

body.$description: Readable paragraph. Use instead of ui when the line wraps as copy, not a control label.

ui.$description: Controls, nav, field text. Default for the prototype.

label.$description: Control label and compact CTA. Use instead of ui when the line names a field or a button.

caption.$description: Meta line, timestamp, badge text. Not body copy.

metric.$description: A number meant to be scanned. Pair with action.primary on dark; not on light.

tight.$description: Inside a control or a tight cluster. Use instead of default when items are one unit.

default.$description: Default stack inside a card or form. Use instead of tight when the group is a section, not a chip.

relaxed.$description: Between groups in a panel. Use instead of default when the blocks are separate thoughts.

section.$description: Between page sections. Not for gaps inside a card.

prefix.$description: Locked width of the Slack / Telegram prefix. Amount fields use 64px, not this token.

default.$description: Cards and panels. Use instead of control when the shape is a surface, not a button.
Open modal and every dialog. Use instead of plate when the surface is the outermost frame.
Inner plates, menus, popovers, select lists, tab list. Concentric inside frame.default with a 24px inset; use instead of control when the shape is a surface.
Buttons, inputs, select triggers, tab triggers, menu rows. Use instead of box.default — controls are tighter than surfaces.

sm.$description: Compact chips inside a card. Use instead of control.default when the control is nested.

pill.$description: Badges and fully round chips. Not for buttons — those use control.default.

shell.$description: Outer radius of the client table.

header.$description: Header radius. Header sits inset 8px, so 16 − 8 stays concentric with table.shell.

brand.$description: Citron bloom behind a hero CTA. Colour is color.citron.500; alpha is stored here because DTCG has no alpha-on-reference. Most surfaces have no shadow — do not use this on admin cards.

color.$description: Hover and focus colour changes. Pair duration.fast with easing.standard. Use instead of default when only colour shifts.

move.$description: Layout or transform. Pair duration.default with easing.standard. Use instead of color when position changes.

default.$description: Height of every text button, input, select trigger, picker trigger, tab trigger and header control. Not for icon buttons inside a table row.
